hero.copy: BUILDING THOUGHTFUL DIGITAL EXPERIENCES FOR WEB AND MOBILE, BRINGING TOGETHER CREATIVE DESIGN, RELIABLE SYSTEMS, AND AI. TURNING IDEAS INTO COMPLETE PRODUCTS THAT LOOK GOOD, WORK WELL, AND FEEL SIMPLE TO USE.

headings.right: Bold systems built to hold attention

items.title: Runman
items.subtitle: Motion mark
items.copy: A lightweight looping motion mark used as a lead-in for the tool reel. It sets the pace before the video studies begin, keeping the section feeling alive from the first frame.

items.title: Chroma Warp
items.subtitle: Type and media
items.copy: A motion study mixing image texture with live typography. Built as a reusable visual tool for quick art direction tests, combining layered media, responsive type, and script-controlled timing.

items.title: Split Mask
items.subtitle: Interactive reveal
items.copy: A compact interaction prototype for opening, masking, and revealing content. Designed around clean motion states, flexible layout logic, and a simple structure that can be reused across digital pieces.

items.title: Text Maze
items.subtitle: Generative system
items.copy: A maze-like remix tool built for playful visual variation. It uses modern front-end scripting, procedural layout behavior, and graphic rules that can shift quickly without losing the overall system.

items.title: Whale
items.subtitle: 3D motion test
items.copy: A sculptural motion experiment focused on weight, depth, and atmospheric movement. Built as a browser-friendly visual test using modern scripts and controlled animation pacing.

items.title: TIME2TRAVEL
items.subtitle: CRYPTO TRAVEL BOOKING WEB APP

items.copy: A TRAVEL BOOKING WEB APP THAT HELPS USERS SEARCH FOR HOTELS AND FLIGHTS, MANAGE BOOKINGS, AND PAY WITH CRYPTOCURRENCY. DESIGNED FOR DESKTOP AND MOBILE, TIME2TRAVEL BRINGS TRAVEL PLANNING AND CRYPTO PAYMENTS TOGETHER IN ONE PLATFORM.

items.title: BFICOIN

items.title: SPARKIT

items.title: SPARKIT
